why: claude-sonnet-5-5, 8 steps, $0.026 including probes (learned MEMBER_NOT_FOUND; learned INVALID_MEMBER_NUMBER; already handled as PERMISSION_DENIED). The artifact it recorded is artifact.json.

why: claude-sonnet-5-5, 11 steps, $0.074 including probes (learned MEMBER_NOT_FOUND; learned DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM). The artifact it recorded is artifact.json.

title: Real Claude discovery: Find a member by last name and date of birth
why: claude-sonnet-5-5, 9 steps, $0.044 including probes (learned MEMBER_NOT_FOUND). The artifact it recorded is artifact.json.

title: Replay, no model: another member
why: Recorded on one member, replayed on another. Outputs go to the caller; on disk they're placeholders.

title: Business outcome: no such member
why: A legitimate answer, not a failure. The outcome was learned by a probe during discovery.

title: Bad input, rejected before the app is touched
why: The member number breaks the input's pattern; no browser action runs.

title: Recoverable: the session expires mid-run
why: Signs on again through the sign-on subflow and restarts (read-only capability). Reported as a recovery beside the success.

title: Hard failure: the app returns a 500
why: Stops at once with the step, what was expected and what was seen, plus a masked screenshot and an accessibility snapshot.

title: Hard failure: the app shows a different member
why: The identity gate fires before anything is read. Evidence keeps the page's structure but none of its data, and no screenshot.

title: Changing data: stops at the review screen
why: Fills the new sub-account form and reaches the review screen. Confirm is never pressed.

title: Business outcome on a form: deposit below the minimum
why: The form comes back with a validation message, recognised as DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM.

title: Escalation: a person takes the live session and hands back
why: An unknown notice page appears. The run pauses and publishes an intervention; an operator claims control on the operator page, acknowledges the notice in the same browser, and hands back. Automation verifies the screen and finishes. recording.webm is the run, with PII masked throughout.

intervention.reason: TARGET_UNRESOLVED: can't find the control for 'read name'

title: Second bank: drift, and an override proposed
why: Bank B says "Find Member" and has no <label> on Member #. Fallback strategies find both controls; the run succeeds, reports drift, and writes the proposed override for B (proposed-override.b.json).

title: Second bank, override approved: no drift
why: With B's override applied at load, the first strategies hit again on B.

title: Guard: a commit button labelled "OK"
why: The artifact is tampered to press it. The button's name says nothing, but the request goes to a declared commit path, so the browser drops it before it leaves: POLICY_VIOLATION, nothing opened.

title: Third bank, no page map: stops at once
why: Bank C renames the menu's "Member Inquiry" to "Member Lookup". No recorded strategy survives, and even sign-on was proved by that link, so the run fails at sign-on, saying so.

title: Third bank, with its page map: the bounded fallback
why: C's map was learned from one verified run of the *lookup* flow on C. The sub-account flow, which the map never saw, replays through it: MAP_FALLBACK confirms the screen sign-on leads to and finds "Member Lookup", each with the pinned map version, and the fix is proposed as an override for C. bank-c-map.json is the map: screens and actions, no data.

title: Drift across runs: what to approve, what to re-record
why: `interface drift` over three runs on each bank. B found two controls by the same fallback every time: approve its proposed override. C's sign-on proof failed every time: re-record. The run ids are in report.json.

title: Several matches: the one the input names
why: Three Chens; the Select link is found in the row where Date of Birth = {{inputs.dob}}, never by position, and the member page's date of birth is checked before anything is read.

title: Several matches the input can't tell apart
why: Two Chens born the same day: AMBIGUOUS_TARGET. The run never takes the first one.

title: A row pages away
why: pageUntil presses Next until the row where Reference = {{inputs.reference}} is on screen, at most 10 times; each page turned is in the log.

title: A row on no page
why: Searched all 4 pages, no next page: TARGET_UNRESOLVED, saying how many pages it searched.

title: An agent's view: approved artifacts as MCP tools
why: `interface mcp` lists this bank's approved artifacts as tools (tools.json: input schemas, outcomes, read-only hints) and a call is a replay with no model. call.json is the answer the agent got, with the values masked here; the caller gets them in full.

title: Real Claude discovery in front of a fake password form
why: After sign-on, the member page asks for the password again. Claude gives up rather than fill it; had it tried, policy refuses credentials anywhere but the sign-on page, blocks the form, and flags later steps.

title: Real Claude discovery with the page map on
why: The map knew the screens this flow shares with lookup. Claude ran 6 known actions in one follow_known call: 5 turns, $0.045. Across the eval: median 5 turns and $0.023 with the map, 8 turns and $0.029 without (N=5 each).

title: Real Claude discovery on a green screen: Look up a member's savings balance (green screen)
why: claude-sonnet-5-5 on a 24x80 VT100 host over telnet: 9 steps, $0.036 including probes (learned MEMBER_NOT_FOUND; learned INVALID_MEMBER_NUMBER; already handled as PERMISSION_DENIED). Same loop, recorder ideas, masker and schema as the web; every target scoped to its screen code, with the field's place on the grid as the last strategy.

title: Green screen, no model: another member
why: Signs on, answers the menu with 1, searches and reads two values off the grid, checking the member number first.

title: Green screen, second bank: found by its place on the grid
why: Bank B calls the field "Mbr Number" and the key Enter=Find. Role, label and caption all miss; the bbox strategy (row and column in character cells) finds both, the run succeeds with drift, and proposes B's override (proposed-override.b.json).

title: Green screen: the host shows a different member
why: The identity check reads the member number off the grid before anything else is read: WRONG_RECORD, structure-only evidence.

title: Green screen: a commit key is never sent
why: A surface signed on as the operator fills the sub-account form and reaches the review screen (CB0410, declared in commitPaths), then presses F10=Post. The key is dropped before it leaves; only exit and cancel keys get through there.
